name: SteamUI-GoldenEra
texts: A fully color-customizable Steam theme with flexible layout options inspired by the classic Steam look.
Adds extra styling on top of existing theme. WARNING: Some theme stylings are not maintained.
Condense Home, Collections buttons, Search bar down to 2 rows
Enables Use of System Accent Color from Millennium's settings.
Moves Bottom Bar of Add a Game, Manage Downloads, Friends & Chat to the top of window.
Override Theme Styling with Extra Themes
Position/visibility of the What's New section in Library
Remove Shine/Glare on game grid images, which can cause discomfort
Removes spacing and shrinks images to fit in more Friends Activity and News
Removes spacing and shrinks images to fit in more Game Events
Replace HOME text with a Home Icon
Show more games with the old style game list
Some themes in Override Theme Styling want this turned off, on by default
Swaps gamepage columns and changes their widths to mimic a Pre-2019 library layout
Thicker scrollbar for ease of use
Tweak gamepage "glass" below the header to be clearer and possibly less uncomfortable
Tweak nav bar to be bigger and text to be more opaque
